subject: onchain.records

entries.definition: A public onchain account identity described by its exact network, governed account type, organizational function, and internal label, whose verified state requires linked completed verification-run evidence.

limitations: This vocabulary defines public account meaning only; it excludes private keys, seed phrases, credentials, signing material, transaction payloads, and execution authority.
Provider and policy projections must bind this exact artifact and fail visibly on drift; copied definitions never become canonical.
